military/camps.title: Military camp
military/camps.lead: Prefabricated softwall shelters and expandable containers engineered for mobility and redeployment by militaries stationed in remote locations. Each camp is customized to your operational requirements, location, transport logistics and budget.

military/c2.title: Command and control
military/c2.lead: Weatherhaven’s expandable containers provide space for a technical command and control centre. They deploy in rugged field conditions, set up quickly on uneven terrain and protect sensitive electronic equipment from the elements.

military/workshops.title: Workshops
military/workshops.lead: First-line and second-line maintenance workshops, custom configured to user requirements and deployment scenarios. They range from softwall shelters for long-term deployment to expandable containers with built-in generators and HVAC for tactical and short-term operations.

military/simulation.title: Simulation and training
military/simulation.lead: When full-scale military exercises are not feasible, Weatherhaven’s MECC and EHMECC expandable containers can be integrated with simulation equipment to train more personnel at reduced cost.

military/uav.title: Unmanned aerial vehicles and satellite systems
military/uav.lead: Mobile shelters for UAV ground control stations and maintenance workshops, and expandable containers that house the hardware to receive and process satellite imagery and data.

medical/field-hospitals.title: Field hospitals
medical/field-hospitals.lead: Fully equipped mobile field hospitals, from 10 beds to hundreds of beds with specialized medical equipment, engineered to function in remote locations for commercial, military and emergency response applications.

medical/clinics.title: Medical clinics
medical/clinics.lead: Mobile clinics that bring medical care to civilians, camp occupants and military personnel in remote areas. They can be configured or reconfigured by adding or removing components or changing interior layouts.

medical/emergency.title: Emergency response
medical/emergency.lead: Custom disaster response shelters designed to your operational needs and budget, for emergencies of any scale, from earthquakes and floods to hurricanes and epidemics.

medical/cbrn.title: CBRN protection and decontamination
medical/cbrn.lead: Mobile shelters and systems for full CBRN decontamination and protection, so militaries and humanitarian organizations can decontaminate equipment, vehicles, personnel and civilians.

commercial/workforce.title: Workforce housing
commercial/workforce.lead: Portable shelters and shelter systems for mining, construction and exploration camps, used by mobile workforces in remote locations in more than 50 countries.

commercial/antarctic.title: Antarctic climate research
commercial/antarctic.lead: Weatherhaven’s product set has long contributed to climate change research in Antarctica. More than 20 of the 32 countries currently conducting climate change research there use Weatherhaven products.

commercial/turnkey.title: Turnkey solutions
commercial/turnkey.lead: Turnkey camps that combine Weatherhaven shelters with camp layout and design, construction, and integrated camp systems such as power, water and waste management.

commercial/luxury.title: Mobile luxury recreation container
commercial/luxury.lead: A fully equipped mobile retreat for all locations and climates, including hot desert. It ships as a 20-foot ISO container, the MECC, and is set up by two people in 20–30 minutes.

services/engineering.title: Engineering and design
services/engineering.lead: From product configurations and drawings to interoperability analysis, Weatherhaven’s engineering and design teams work with you to create a mobile shelter solution that meets your requirements.

services/logistics.title: Transportation and logistics
services/logistics.lead: Weatherhaven shelters are designed for transport to remote locations, and its logistics team handles international shipping and documentation. A fabric camp with space for 96 beds ships in one 20-foot container.

services/installation.title: Installation and dismantling
services/installation.lead: Shelters and shelter systems engineered for quick set-up and dismantling through prefabrication and quick-connect electrical, mechanical and furnishing components. Weatherhaven can supply supervisors and a full workforce, or supervisors to work with your personnel.

services/training.title: Training and in-service support
services/training.lead: Custom training packages and in-service support to help you set up and maintain Weatherhaven shelters and shelter systems, and keep new and existing equipment in service for decades.

services/repair.title: Repair and overhaul
services/repair.lead: Weatherhaven inspects, repairs, overhauls and upgrades shelters and shelter systems to the latest standard, so they are ready for future deployments.

services/parts.title: Parts
services/parts.lead: Repair parts and complete spare parts packages for all the portable shelters and systems Weatherhaven provides.

support/ablutions.title: Ablutions and washhouses
support/ablutions.lead: From a single bathroom within a shelter to a complete facility with toilets, sinks and showers, for commercial, military and medical operations.

support/kitchens.title: Kitchens
support/kitchens.lead: Redeployable mobile kitchens, from a single tactical kitchen to a full-service kitchen that feeds 1,000 people three fresh meals a day.

support/laundry.title: Laundry
support/laundry.lead: Redeployable batch and self-serve field laundry for 250 to 500 people, fully operational in less than one hour once connected to power, water and effluent catchment.

support/sleeping.title: Sleeping quarters
support/sleeping.lead: Climate-controlled sleeping quarters for workforces, soldiers and humanitarians, in Series 4, Series 8 and MTS softwall shelters or the HERCon hardwall expandable container.

support/floors.title: Floors
support/floors.lead: A large selection of flooring for any terrain and shelter application, from tactical floors for frequent relocation to economical floors for long-term deployments.

support/emw.title: Electrical, mechanical and water
support/emw.lead: Pre-assembled electrical kits, custom-designed mechanical systems and water systems, shipped with or integrated into Weatherhaven shelters.

support/mobilizers.title: Mobilizers and trailers
support/mobilizers.lead: Mobilizers and trailers to move the EHMECC, MECC and TRECC, including the LH55 ISO Container Mobilizer and the Mobility Trailer. The containers stay fully functional when deployed on either.

support/security.title: Security
support/security.lead: Force-protection barriers, high-security perimeter or electric fencing, and lighting towers for Weatherhaven turnkey military camps, procured through Weatherhaven’s partner network and global supply chain.

accessories/solarshade.title: Solarshade
accessories/solarshade.lead: Solarshades are used with Weatherhaven shelters in areas of extreme, direct solar radiation. They give 70 percent shade coverage and block 95 percent of UV rays.

accessories/interconnectors.title: Interconnectors and corridors
accessories/interconnectors.lead: Interconnectors and corridors link Weatherhaven shelters into a complex, so occupants and equipment move between shelters protected from the weather and, in tactical situations, from visual observation.
